tasks.title: Add depth field and skip guard to investigator agent
tasks.description: Update agents/investigator.md to add a `depth` field (optional, enum fast|deep, default deep) to the Input contract section. Add a one-line skip guard at the top of step 4 (Bounded expansion / adjacent_facts): 'If depth == fast, skip this step and proceed to step 5.' Add a fast/deep guidance block near step 4 (non-binding): fast = one self-contained falsifiable fact where adjacent context won't change the action; deep = act-on-context, incident triage, why/how, or multi-claim. Absent depth field defaults to deep, preserving all existing caller behavior.
acceptance_criteria: agents/investigator.md Input section contains depth field documented as optional, enum fast|deep, default deep
Step 4 in agents/investigator.md opens with a skip guard: 'If depth == fast, skip this step and proceed to step 5'
Fast/deep guidance block is present near step 4 with the two-case rule (fast vs deep)
Existing callers (pr-revise, pr-code-review) that pass no depth field are unaffected by the change
tasks.summary: Added optional depth field (fast|deep, default deep) to investigator.md Input contract, a skip guard at the top of step 4, and a non-binding fast/deep guidance block; existing callers passing no depth field are unaffected.

tasks.title: Add fast/deep depth prompt to investigate skill
tasks.description: Update skills/investigate/SKILL.md to present an AskUserQuestion prompt before routing to the investigator. The prompt uses header 'Depth', question 'Fast or deep answer?', with Fast listed first (literal answer only, verdict+evidence, skips adjacent-facts, fewer spawns, quicker) and Deep listed second (full investigation + adjacent facts, more spawns, slower). If the user's $ARGUMENTS contain the explicit word 'fast' or 'deep', skip the prompt entirely and honor the explicit choice. After selection (or auto-detection), append `depth: fast` or `depth: deep` to the investigator prompt string. The investigate skill already parses --out raw|slack in Step 0; the depth prompt is a separate concern handled as its own step or a parallel parse in the same step.
acceptance_criteria: skills/investigate/SKILL.md contains an AskUserQuestion step with header 'Depth' and two options: Fast and Deep
Explicit 'fast' or 'deep' in $ARGUMENTS bypasses the AskUserQuestion prompt
The investigator prompt string receives `depth: fast` or `depth: deep` appended based on the selection
Running the investigate skill without an explicit depth flag surfaces the fast/deep prompt before investigation begins
tasks.summary: Added fast/deep depth resolution to SKILL.md: Step 0 now detects explicit 'fast'/'deep' in $ARGUMENTS (bypassing the prompt) or surfaces an AskUserQuestion with header 'Depth' and Fast/Deep options; Step 3 always appends `depth: <value>` to the investigator prompt string.
